about: lit-v1 §7 replay vectors: each sequence judges its records in order against one segment's state from empty; see conformance/README.md.

sequences.name: issue, pay with change, burn, present and settle

steps.description: K issues 10 to Alice
Alice pays Bob 6 with 4 change
Alice burns 3 of her change, keeping 1
Bob presents his 6
K settles Bob's demand to Carol
K issues 10 to Alice
a spend naming another segment
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Common: the segment is this one

steps.description: an issue under another configuration's domain
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Common: the domain is the configuration's

steps.description: a request in the history
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Request: never admitted

steps.description: an issue of a backing outside the scope
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Common: every backing named or derived is in the segment's scope

steps.description: a spend of a note never created
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Common: an input's cm is in the output set

steps.description: a demand on a note never created
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Common: an input's cm is in the output set

steps.description: a spend of one note twice in one statement
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Common: the inputs' nullifiers are distinct

steps.description: a spend whose outputs sum below its inputs
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Spend: per input backing, the inputs' widened sum equals the outputs'

steps.description: a spend to a backing no input names, signed by another key
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Spend: every output's backing is an input's

steps.description: a burn of more than its inputs
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Burn: the inputs' sum equals quantity plus the output's value

steps.description: a spend Mallory signs for Alice's note
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Spend: owner signatures verify

steps.description: an issue Mallory signs in K's place
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Issue: K's signature verifies over statementBytes

steps.description: an issue taking the backing's issued total to 2^64
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Issue: issued(backing) + quantity < 2^64

steps.description: the first issue again, byte for byte
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Common: an exact resubmission returns the original receipt and is no second event

steps.description: Alice pays Bob 10
Alice's spent note paid again, to Carol
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Common: an input's nf is not in the spent set

steps.description: K issues 10 to Alice
a settlement of a demand never made
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: the demand stands

steps.description: a withdrawal of a demand never made
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Withdraw: C3.7, the demand stands

steps.description: a demand Mallory signs for Alice's note
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Demand: owner signatures verify

steps.description: the presenter demands Alice's 10
a second demand on the locked note
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Demand: every input's tag is under no standing lock

steps.description: a spend of the locked note
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Spend: every input's tag is under no standing lock (C3.7)

steps.description: a withdrawal Mallory signs
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Withdraw: the presenter's signature is over the withdraw statement's bytes

steps.description: a settlement whose acceptance Mallory signs in K's place
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: the acceptance verifies under K

steps.description: a settlement to Carol whose owner signature is K's
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: the acceptance verifies under this owner

steps.description: a settlement back to Alice, the holder, without her owner signature
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: the acceptance verifies under this owner

steps.description: a settlement to the presenter's key signed by Mallory
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: the acceptance verifies under this owner

steps.description: a settlement whose release Mallory signs
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: the release verifies under the presenter key

steps.description: a settlement whose acceptance deadline passes the demand's
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: C3.7, the acceptance deadline within the demand's

steps.description: the presenter withdraws the demand
Alice, released, pays Bob 10
a demand on the spent note
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Demand: every input's tag is neither locked nor spent

steps.description: K issues 10 to Alice
K issues 4 to Bob
a two-input spend signed in the wrong order
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Spend: owner signatures verify, each under its own input's owner

steps.description: the presenter demands Alice's 10
K settles the demand to Carol
the same settlement again
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: the demand stands

steps.description: a settlement of the settled demand to Bob
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Settle: the demand stands

steps.description: K issues 10 of the first backing to Alice
K issues 10 of the second backing to Alice
a burn over both backings
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Burn: one input backing

steps.description: a demand over both backings
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Demand: the inputs share one backing

steps.description: a demand whose inputs sum past a u64
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Demand: the inputs' summed value is a u64

steps.description: Alice pays Bob both, balanced per backing
K issues 5 to Alice, a note whose nullifier and tag both exceed the BN254 scalar field
the presenter demands it
a spend of the locked note
steps.rule: lit-v1 §7 Spend: every input's tag is under no standing lock (C3.7)
